description: This Java source file defines the implementation class for the ThingsFieldExpressionFactory interface, providing functionality to create field expressions for filtering, existence checks, and sorting based on property names, with support for custom mappings and feature field parsing.

classes.name: ThingsFieldExpressionFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ThingsFieldExpressionFactory interface providing methods to create various field expressions.

methods.name: filterBy
methods.description: Creates a filter expression based on the provided property name, handling feature IDs and properties if present.

methods.name: existsBy
methods.description: Creates an exists expression to determine if a property or feature ID exists.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Creates a sort expression based on the property, considering feature IDs.

methods.name: stripLeadingSlash
methods.description: Removes a leading slash from the property name if present.

methods.name: common
methods.description: Internal factory method for generating field expressions for attribute or definition fields, or fallback mappings.
